name: Hookahdra
look: a glass-and-brass hookah sea serpent: a bubbling glass vase body, a brass stem and coal bowl, and three braided teal hose necks ending in serpent heads with brass mouthpiece snouts
entry: By drawing air through its water-filled belly, Hookahdra cools down its internal furnace, releasing sweet-smelling clouds from its many snouts.
how: Evolve Bongwater at level 36. It learns Dragon Pulse when it evolves.
Wild: rare in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
